trap.label: falso cognato: experience
trap.wrong: The scientist had an experience in the lab.
trap.right: The scientist did an experiment in the lab.
trap.why: Em português "experiência" é experimento. Em inglês, experience = vivência; o teste é experiment.

mcq.q: Complete: The study **___** that it works.

fix.wrong: The team told that it works.
fix.right: The team said that it works.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com suggest that: “Data show a link.”
rewrite.answer: The data suggest that there is a link.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com non-defining: “Dr. Lee is my aunt. She studies cells.”
rewrite.answer: Dr. Lee, who studies cells, is my aunt.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Scientists tested the drug.”
